entry.title: StreetLens — Cambridgeshire & Peterborough: data updated
entry.summary: Recorded crimes in the 12 months 2025-10 to 2026-09: 83,673 (88.8 per 1,000 residents). Year-on-year +2.5%. Figures are police-recorded and locations are anonymised. Not a substitute for official community messaging.
